result.query: Extract concrete promotional offers from the content below — the specific offer or campaign, the product/card it applies to, the benefit or discount amount, and the validity dates where stated. source_code for these signals is "VCB".

signals.summary: Special Offer for New VCB DigiAds Cardholders: VND 500,000 cashback when a new VCB DigiAds card is issued and the customer spends at least VND 20 million on eligible advertising during the promotion period.

VCB DigiAds card tiered cashback: spend VND 100 million on eligible advertising to receive VND 800,000 cashback; spend VND 300 million for VND 3,000,000; spend VND 800 million for VND 8,000,000; spend VND 1.5 billion for VND 15,000,000. Only the highest tier reward applies, with a maximum of VND 15,000,000 per customer for the entire program.
Vietcombank Visa credit and debit cardholders making advertising-related transactions (MCC 7311, 5960‑5969) are eligible for cashback up to VND 10,000,000 per customer during the program period.

100% refund of foreign currency transaction processing fees for overseas POS purchases made with Vietcombank Visa Signature cards, up to VND 1,500,000 per customer; eligible for transactions of VND 2,000,000 or more.
signals.reference_period: Phase 1: 6 June 2026 to 31 July 2026; Phase 2 dates not specified

--- https://www.vietcombank.com.vn/en/Personal/Truy-cap-nhanh/KHCN---Danh-sach-uu-dai/Manh-tay-vit-ads-hoan-tien-dam-sau ---
Vietcombank offers up to VND 15 million cashback when you apply for a VCB DigiAds card and spend on advertising.
1.	Special Offer for New VCB DigiAds Cardholders
​
Customers who establish a new banking relationship with Vietcombank and successfully issue a VCB DigiAds card during the promotion period will receive VND 500,000 Cashback when achieving a minimum of VND 20 million in eligible advertising spend during the promotion period.
2.	Spend More on Advertising, Earn Bigger Rewards
​
VCB DigiAds cardholders can earn rewards based on their cumulative eligible advertising spend throughout the promotion period:
Eligible Advertising Spend
Cashback Reward
From VND 100 million
VND 800,000
From VND 300 million
VND 3,000,000
From VND 800 million
VND 8,000,000
From VND 1.5 billion
VND 15,000,000
Notes:
•	Customers who qualify for the New Customer Offer may continue to participate in Offer 2 – Increase Your Advertising Spend.
•	Customers are eligible to receive only one reward, corresponding to the highest reward tier achieved during the promotion period.
•	Each customer is eligible for a maximum reward of VND 15,000,000 throughout the entire promotion program.

--- https://www.vietcombank.com.vn/en/Personal/Truy-cap-nhanh/KHCN---Danh-sach-uu-dai/30072026---Chi-tieu-quoc-te-hoan-tien-xung-tam ---
Get a 100% refund on foreign currency transaction processing fees for overseas POS purchases made with Vietcombank Visa Signature cards:
Maximum cashback: VND 1,500,000 per customer.
Eligible transactions: Overseas purchases with a transaction value of VND 2,000,000 or more.
Payment channel: POS terminals.
Total programme budget: VND 3,129,909,090.
Important notes:
​
For customers who participated in Phase 1 of the programme, from 6 June 2026 to 31 July 2026, and received cashback:
Customers who received the maximum cashback amount of VND 1,500,000 per CIF will not be eligible for cashback in Phase 2.
Customers who received less than VND 1,500,000 per CIF will remain eligible for cashback consideration in Phase 2.
However, the total cashback received by each customer across both phases must not exceed VND 1,500,000 per CIF.
